version.description: The file's format version. Aphelion migrates older ones.

name.description: Unique bot name. Also the name of the bot's folder (decision 0010).

provider.description: The bot CLI that runs the bot.

connectors.description: Ids of the connectors the bot may use. Can be empty.

policyProfile.description: The approval profile the bot's actions pass.

folder.description: Absolute path of the bot's folder. Normally the bot's name under /var/lib/aphelion-bots.

bots.description: One entry per bot. Names must be unique.

title: bots.yaml
description: What each bot is allowed to do. Instructions live in the bot's folder, not here (decision 0010).
